verdict.rationale: Convertio documents a fixed retention policy: uploaded files are deleted instantly and converted files after 24 hours. That gives users a predictable deletion outcome, but nothing shows they can configure retention or trigger deletion themselves. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods, on-demand deletion (e.g., an API delete endpoint or account-level data purge), detailed privacy/retention documentation, and independent verification that deletion actually happens.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: We delete uploaded files instantly and converted ones after 24 hours.
